I have been farming beans on this small plot for many years, and I know beans do not need chemical fertilizer because they pull nitrogen from the air. I will spread cattle manure on the soil before planting, and I will use the seeds I saved from last season's harvest. My family can manage all the work on just 0.25 hectares, so I do not need to hire anyone or buy expensive chemicals.
